title: The Sacred Quest
tagline: A protagonist embarks on a journey to obtain a specific prize, destination, treasure, person, or achievement.
coreDefinition: A protagonist embarks on a journey to obtain a specific prize, destination, treasure, person, or achievement. There is an objective and a transformational journey. By the time the hero reaches the prize, they discover that the greatest reward was not what they found, but who they became.
coreDramaticQuestion: Will the hero obtain the prize they seek, and what will the journey teach them about themselves?

engines.plot: Reach the destination or obtain the prize.
engines.theme: The journey changes us more than the destination.

themes.fear: "What if I spend my whole life chasing the wrong thing?"
themes.desire: "What if the journey helps me become the person I was meant to be?"

heroArc.beginning: "My happiness lies in obtaining that prize.”
heroArc.end: "The real treasure was the growth I earned along the way."
heroArc.external: Reach the destination. Find the treasure. Complete the mission. Return transformed.

films: The Lord of the Rings Trilogy
The Secret Life of Walter Mitty

plotStructure.actI: Hero lacks something • The prize is revealed • Call to adventure • Hero leaves home.
plotStructure.actII: Road of trials begins • Companions join the journey • Obstacles increase • Midpoint reveals the prize may not be what the hero truly needs • Hero grows through hardship.
plotStructure.actIII: Final approach to the destination • Greatest challenge emerges • Prize is obtained or reached • Hero realizes the deeper meaning of the journey • Returns transformed.

commonMistakes: Obstacles do not transform the hero
Theme becomes only about adventure instead of growth
No meaningful internal revelation at the end

title: The Heartbound Pair
tagline: Two people who are emotionally incomplete discover love through a relationship that transforms both of them.
coreDefinition: Two people who are emotionally incomplete discover love through a relationship that transforms both of them. Involves falling in love and both becoming complete through the other person.
coreDramaticQuestion: Will these two people overcome the forces keeping them apart and become stronger together than they could ever be alone?

engines.plot: Two people develop an emotional bond.
engines.story: Each possesses something the other lacks.
engines.theme: Love is not finding someone perfect; it is becoming whole through connection.

themes.fear: "What if I never find the person who truly understands me?"
themes.desire: "What if someone could love me completely and help me become my best self?"

heroArchetypes: Cynic Who Stops Believing In Love

heroArc.end: "My life is better because of us."
heroArc.external: Build, lose, and ultimately secure the relationship.

plotStructure.actI: Incomplete Lives: Both characters are missing something emotionally • Meet Cute / Collision: Relationship begins through attraction, conflict, accident, or necessity. • Complication Introduced: Something makes the relationship difficult.
plotStructure.actII: Growing Connection: They spend time together. • Emotional Resistance: One or both resist intimacy. • Midpoint: They realize this relationship matters.
plotStructure.actIII: Separation: The complication tears them apart. • Crisis: Life without the other feels incomplete. • Climax: One or both choose love despite the cost • Resolution: They unite emotionally and/or physically.

coreDefinition: Ordinary people become trapped with a deadly monster and must survive long enough to escape or destroy it. Fight for survival with potential for horror / thriller movements.

engines.theme: Fear reveals who people truly are.

themes.fear: "What if something unstoppable is hunting me?"
themes.desire: "What if I can survive even the worst nightmare?"

heroArc.external: Escape or kill the monster.

themes.desire: "What if one person can make a difference?"

heroArc.beginning: *"No one could truly love someone like me."*
heroArc.external: Win both love and respect by remaining true to oneself.

plotStructure.actI: Hero introduced as overlooked • Love interest appears • Hero underestimated.
plotStructure.actII: Relationship develops through sincerity • Rival creates conflict • Hero refuses to compromise authenticity.
plotStructure.actIII: Truth revealed • Love chooses character over status • Hero triumphs through genuine self-worth.

commonMistakes: Hero succeeds through luck instead of character
Ending rewards popularity instead of authenticity.

title: Love in Institutions
tagline: A Love in Institutions story is about two people whose relationship develops within, or is threatened by, a powerful institution such as a family, corporation, military, religion, government, school, or criminal organization.
coreDefinition: A Love in Institutions story is about two people whose relationship develops within, or is threatened by, a powerful institution such as a family, corporation, military, religion, government, school, or criminal organization. A conflict between individual desire and collective loyalty.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can love survive when loyalty to an institution demands personal sacrifice?

engines.plot: Two people struggle to build a lasting relationship.
engines.story: Individual desire clashes with the rules of the group.
engines.theme: Love ultimately requires choosing authenticity over blind conformity.

themes.fear: *"What if the people I love force me to choose between them and my own identity?"*
themes.desire: *"What if love can overcome even the strongest systems?"*

heroArc.end: *"Love deserves loyalty greater than any institution."*
heroArc.external: Escape, reform, or survive the institution while preserving the relationship.

plotStructure.actI: Institution introduced • Relationship begins • Rules forbid or discourage intimacy.
plotStructure.actII: Institution pressures the couple • Loyalty conflicts deepen • One partner chooses duty over love • Midpoint forces an impossible decision.
plotStructure.actIII: Institution becomes openly hostile • Love either transforms the institution or escapes it • Relationship reaches final commitment or tragic separation.

title: Love in Horror
tagline: A Love in Horror story follows two people whose growing relationship is tested while trapped with a deadly monster.
coreDefinition: A Love in Horror story follows two people whose growing relationship is tested while trapped with a deadly monster.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can love survive when death is constantly hunting them?

engines.theme: Genuine love is proven through sacrifice under fear.

themes.fear: *"What if I lose the person I love before I can protect them?"*
themes.desire: *"What if love gives us the strength to face impossible terror?"*

heroArc.external: Defeat or escape the monster together.

plotStructure.actI: Monster appears • Two strangers or lovers become trapped • Survival begins.
plotStructure.actII: Relationship deepens • Monster attacks escalate • One partner is endangered • Midpoint reveals monster weakness.
plotStructure.actIII: Ultimate sacrifice • Final confrontation • Love survives—or one lover dies saving the other.

title: Magical Love
tagline: A Magical Love story explores how supernatural powers, wishes, curses, or magical transformations bring two people together while forcing them to discover what genuine love truly means.
coreDefinition: A Magical Love story explores how supernatural powers, wishes, curses, or magical transformations bring two people together while forcing them to discover what genuine love truly means.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can love survive after the illusion of magical perfection disappears?

engines.story: Magic grants desires but creates unexpected consequences.
engines.theme: Real love comes from acceptance, not fantasy.

themes.fear: *"What if getting everything I wished for destroys the love I wanted?"*
themes.desire: *"What if someone could love me without magic?"*

heroArc.external: Reverse or overcome the magical condition while preserving the relationship.

plotStructure.actI: Magic enters ordinary life • Romantic possibility emerges • Wish is granted.
plotStructure.actII: Magic improves the relationship • Unexpected consequences appear • Love becomes dependent upon illusion • Midpoint exposes the hidden cost.
plotStructure.actIII: Magic must disappear • Characters choose authentic love • Relationship survives reality.

commonMistakes: Ending relies on deus ex machina

title: Love Passage
tagline: A Love Passage story follows two people whose relationship becomes the catalyst for profound emotional growth during a major life transition.
coreDefinition: A Love Passage story follows two people whose relationship becomes the catalyst for profound emotional growth during a major life transition. This a relationship arc with an internal journey toward maturity, acceptance, or healing.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can love help two people become who they are meant to be?

engines.theme: Love matures only when individuals mature.

themes.fear: *"What if the person I love changes beyond recognition?"*
themes.desire: *"What if love helps me become my best self?"*

heroArc.end: *"I must become whole before I can truly love."*
heroArc.external: Navigate life's transition while preserving—or rediscovering—the relationship.

plotStructure.actI: Life transition begins • Relationship forms or is tested • Emotional wounds surface.
plotStructure.actII: Love deepens • Internal resistance increases • Characters confront painful truths • Midpoint brings emotional breakthrough.
plotStructure.actIII: Acceptance replaces denial • Relationship transforms through maturity • Love survives because both characters have changed.

commonMistakes: Conflict relies only on external obstacles
Ending feels sentimental instead of earned

title: Love Hero
tagline: A Love Hero story follows an extraordinary individual whose greatest strength is not merely their supernatural ability or destiny, but their capacity to love despite the burdens of power.
coreDefinition: A Love Hero story follows an extraordinary individual whose greatest strength is not merely their supernatural ability or destiny, but their capacity to love despite the burdens of power. Love becomes both the hero's greatest motivation and greatest vulnerability. The story explores whether love strengthens heroism or becomes the sacrifice required to save others.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can a hero protect both the world and the person they love without losing either?

engines.plot: Deep emotional connection drives every decision.
engines.theme: Love gives power meaning, but every gift demands sacrifice.

themes.fear: "What if loving someone makes them my greatest weakness?"
themes.desire: "What if love is the greatest superpower of all?"

heroArc.beginning: "My mission is more important than personal relationships."
heroArc.end: "Love is the reason worth fighting for."
heroArc.external: Defeat the nemesis while protecting the loved one.

plotStructure.actI: Hero introduced • Love interest established • Nemesis threatens both world and relationship.
plotStructure.actII: Relationship deepens • Hero forced to choose duty over love • Love becomes target.
plotStructure.actIII: Final confrontation • Hero embraces love rather than rejecting it • Love enables ultimate victory.

title: Love Mystery
tagline: A Love Mystery explores how investigation into hidden truths uncovers the complexities of love.
coreDefinition: A Love Mystery explores how investigation into hidden truths uncovers the complexities of love. As secrets emerge, the protagonist realizes the mystery is less about solving a crime and more about understanding the emotional motives behind betrayal, devotion, jealousy, and sacrifice.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can uncovering the truth save love, or will truth destroy it forever?

engines.theme: Love and truth rarely coexist without pain.

themes.fear: "What if the person I love has been lying to me?"
themes.desire: "What if love can survive the truth?"

heroArc.external: Solve the mystery while preserving emotional integrity.

plotStructure.actI: Love relationship introduced • Crime or mystery occurs • Investigation begins.
plotStructure.actII: Clues expose hidden emotional truths • Relationships fracture • Dark turn forces personal involvement.
plotStructure.actIII: Secret revealed • Love survives or dies • Emotional resolution follows mystery.

commonMistakes: Ending resolves mystery but not relationship

title: Mature Bonds
tagline: A Mature Bonds story follows two people whose relationship becomes the catalyst for emotional adulthood.
coreDefinition: A Mature Bonds story follows two people whose relationship becomes the catalyst for emotional adulthood. Through shared experiences, conflict, forgiveness, and mutual support, both individuals evolve from immaturity into deeper emotional understanding.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can two imperfect people grow together into emotionally mature partners?

engines.theme: We mature through meaningful relationships.

themes.fear: "What if I never become the person someone deserves?"
themes.desire: "What if growing together creates lasting love?"

heroArc.external: Relationship survives life's transitions.

plotStructure.actI: Relationship established • Immaturity creates conflict • Shared journey begins.
plotStructure.actII: Both face emotional setbacks • Each helps the other grow • Relationship deepens.
plotStructure.actIII: Final emotional test • Relationship survives through maturity • Future embraced together.

commonMistakes: Growth occurs only for one character

title: Mature Crisis
tagline: A Mature Crisis story places an ordinary individual into an unexpected life-threatening situation where survival demands emotional adulthood.
coreDefinition: A Mature Crisis story places an ordinary individual into an unexpected life-threatening situation where survival demands emotional adulthood. External danger forces rapid personal growth as the protagonist learns responsibility, courage, and resilience.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can an ordinary person grow up quickly enough to survive extraordinary circumstances?

engines.theme: Crisis accelerates maturity.

themes.fear: "What if life forces me to grow up before I'm ready?"
themes.desire: "What if I discover strength I never knew I had?"

heroArc.external: Survive the crisis through newfound maturity.

plotStructure.actI: Ordinary life • Unexpected crisis • Escape impossible.
plotStructure.actII: Repeated failures • Growing competence • Responsibility accepted.
plotStructure.actIII: Final survival challenge • Hero succeeds through maturity • Life forever changed.

title: Metamorphic Bonds
tagline: A Metamorphic Bonds story explores how profound transformation—physical, psychological, supernatural, or existential—tests and ultimately reshapes an important relationship.
coreDefinition: A Metamorphic Bonds story explores how profound transformation—physical, psychological, supernatural, or existential—tests and ultimately reshapes an important relationship. As one or both characters undergo dramatic change, love, friendship, or partnership must evolve or perish. The relationship survives only if both individuals learn to accept who the other is becoming rather than who they once were.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can love or friendship endure when one person becomes someone fundamentally different?

engines.plot: One or both characters undergo profound change.
engines.theme: Genuine love accepts transformation rather than resisting it.

themes.internal: Acceptance vs Fear of Losing Someone
themes.fear: "What if the person I love changes so much that I no longer recognize them?"
themes.desire: "What if true love survives even our greatest transformations?"

heroArc.beginning: "I need you to stay the way you've always been."
heroArc.external: Navigate extraordinary transformation while preserving the relationship.

plotStructure.actI: Strong relationship established • Transformation begins • Both struggle to understand the change.
plotStructure.actII: Transformation intensifies • Relationship becomes strained • Acceptance seems impossible.
plotStructure.actIII: Final transformation completed • Relationship is tested one last time • Love adapts, creating a stronger bond.

commonMistakes: Relationship becomes secondary to the fantasy element
Change feels arbitrary rather than meaningful
Ending restores the status quo instead of embracing transformation

title: Metamorphic Quest
tagline: A protagonist embarks on a journey toward a coveted destination or objective while undergoing a profound transformation of identity.
coreDefinition: A protagonist embarks on a journey toward a coveted destination or objective while undergoing a profound transformation of identity. The external expedition becomes inseparable from an internal metamorphosis, where the traveler returns as an entirely different person from the one who began the quest.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can the protagonist complete the journey while embracing the person they are becoming?

engines.story: Journey toward an external goal transforms the traveler.
engines.theme: True transformation comes through experience rather than achievement.

themes.fear: *"What if I lose myself while chasing my dreams?"*
themes.desire: *"What if the journey reveals who I was meant to become?"*

heroArc.end: *"The journey has transformed me into someone new."*
heroArc.external: Complete the expedition and claim the destination while accepting personal transformation.

films: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty

plotStructure.actI: Hero begins an important journey • Goal appears clear • First signs of inner change emerge.
plotStructure.actII: New worlds reshape beliefs • Identity evolves through challenges • Old self becomes increasingly inadequate.
plotStructure.actIII: Final transformation is accepted • External goal is achieved • Hero returns fundamentally changed.

commonMistakes: Journey changes only circumstances, not identity

title: Pursuit of Love
tagline: Two individuals pursue one another—or a shared objective—while their relationship develops through constant movement, conflict, and cooperation.
coreDefinition: Two individuals pursue one another—or a shared objective—while their relationship develops through constant movement, conflict, and cooperation. The chase becomes the catalyst for emotional intimacy and mutual growth.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can two people pursuing the same objective discover that their greatest reward is each other?

engines.plot: Continuous chase toward a moving objective.
engines.theme: Love develops through persistence and partnership.

themes.fear: *"What if chasing my goal costs me meaningful relationships?"*
themes.desire: *"What if the person beside me is the true prize?"*

heroArc.end: *"I would rather succeed together than alone."*
heroArc.external: Catch the target or complete the pursuit while strengthening the partnership.

plotStructure.actI: Partners unite reluctantly • Pursuit begins • Relationship remains strained.
plotStructure.actII: Chase intensifies • Shared dangers create trust • Emotional bond deepens.
plotStructure.actIII: Final confrontation • Pursuit ends • Relationship becomes the true victory.

title: Rebellion Mystery
tagline: An investigator uncovers hidden truths within an oppressive system and gradually realizes that exposing the mystery requires rebellion against the very institution protecting the secret.
coreDefinition: An investigator uncovers hidden truths within an oppressive system and gradually realizes that exposing the mystery requires rebellion against the very institution protecting the secret. Solving the case becomes an act of resistance.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can the investigator reveal the truth before the corrupt system destroys them?

engines.story: Reveal the hidden motive behind the crime.
engines.theme: Truth demands resistance against corruption.

themes.fear: *"What if telling the truth destroys my life?"*
themes.desire: *"What if exposing corruption changes the world?"*

heroArc.external: Expose the conspiracy and survive institutional retaliation.

plotStructure.actI: Suspicious incident • Investigation begins • First institutional resistance appears.
plotStructure.actII: Deeper conspiracy emerges • Hero breaks rules • Powerful enemies retaliate.
plotStructure.actIII: Truth exposed • Institution challenged • Personal cost accepted.

commonMistakes: Corruption lacks believable motive. Rebellion feels unnecessary
Hero never pays a personal price

title: Underdog Mystery
tagline: An underestimated investigator, amateur detective, or overlooked individual solves a mystery that experts cannot.
coreDefinition: An underestimated investigator, amateur detective, or overlooked individual solves a mystery that experts cannot. The protagonist's unconventional thinking and persistence uncover truths ignored by everyone else.
coreDramaticQuestion: Can the underestimated investigator solve the mystery despite being dismissed by everyone around them?

engines.story: Reveal hidden motives behind the crime.
engines.theme: Insight often belongs to those society ignores.

themes.fear: *"What if no one ever believes me?"*
themes.desire: *"What if I can prove everyone wrong?"*

heroArc.external: Solve the mystery before the true culprit escapes justice.

novels: *The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time*

plotStructure.actI: Mystery introduced • Hero underestimated • Investigation begins despite opposition.
plotStructure.actII: Clues accumulate • Hero faces ridicule • Hidden pattern finally emerges.
plotStructure.actIII: Final revelation • Culprit exposed • Hero earns respect through truth.

commonMistakes: Hero succeeds through luck instead of intelligence
Clues feel unfair to the audience
